title: Isaiah 26: A Song of Salvation and the Straight Gate
body:
Read the chapter → [Isaiah 26](/bible/isaiah/26)

This session moves through [Isaiah 26](/bible/isaiah/26) to 29, opening with the class disclaimer that Israel United in Christ is a non-violent, Bible-based movement that condemns violence against any race, ethnicity, or gender, citing [Leviticus 5:1](/bible/leviticus/5#v1) on the duty to report any plot of harm to the proper authorities. Chapter 26 is a future song of salvation sung in Judah, turning on the straight gate through which only the righteous nation that keeps the truth may enter, and on the judgments the Most High will bring down upon the lofty nations. Chapter 27 punishes Leviathan and gathers the scattered children of Israel. Chapter 28 pronounces woe on the proud drunkards of Ephraim who are drunk with philosophies rather than the law, and lays out the method of study: precept upon precept, line upon line. Chapter 29 brings judgment on Ariel and exposes the spiritual blindness that keeps Israel asleep until the deaf hear the words of the book.

**[Isaiah 26:1-3](/bible/isaiah/26#v1)**

> <sup>[1](/bible/isaiah/26#v1)</sup> In that day shall this song be sung in the land of Judah; We have a strong city; salvation will God appoint for walls and bulwarks.
>
> <sup>[2](/bible/isaiah/26#v2)</sup> Open ye the gates, that the righteous nation which keepeth the truth may enter in.
>
> <sup>[3](/bible/isaiah/26#v3)</sup> Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.

- This is a future prophecy: in that day this song shall be sung in the land of Judah, a joyous song of salvation, with a strong city whose walls and bulwarks are salvation appointed by the Most High.
- The gates are opened that the righteous nation which keepeth the truth may enter in, and that nation is the remnant that keeps the commandments. Whose mind is stayed on the Most High is kept in perfect peace because he trusteth in Him.
  - **[Psalms 118:19-20](/bible/psalms/118#v19)**
    > <sup>[19](/bible/psalms/118#v19)</sup> Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, and I will praise the Lord:
    >
    > <sup>[20](/bible/psalms/118#v20)</sup> This gate of the Lord, into which the righteous shall enter.

    Open to me the gates of righteousness; that gate of the Most High into which the righteous shall enter is the straight gate.
  - **[Matthew 7:13-14](/bible/matthew/7#v13)**
    > <sup>[13](/bible/matthew/7#v13)</sup> Enter ye in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:
    >
    > <sup>[14](/bible/matthew/7#v14)</sup> Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it.

    Christ speaks of the strait gate and narrow way that leadeth unto life, which few find.
  - **[Deuteronomy 6:25](/bible/deuteronomy/6#v25)**
    > <sup>[25](/bible/deuteronomy/6#v25)</sup> And it shall be our righteousness, if we observe to do all these commandments before the Lord our God, as he hath commanded us.

    It shall be our righteousness to keep the commandments; that straight gate is the law, turning neither to the left nor the right.

**[Isaiah 26:4-6](/bible/isaiah/26#v4)**

> <sup>[4](/bible/isaiah/26#v4)</sup> Trust ye in the Lord for ever: for in the Lord Jehovah is everlasting strength:
>
> <sup>[5](/bible/isaiah/26#v5)</sup> For he bringeth down them that dwell on high; the lofty city, he layeth it low; he layeth it low, even to the ground; he bringeth it even to the dust.
>
> <sup>[6](/bible/isaiah/26#v6)</sup> The foot shall tread it down, even the feet of the poor, and the steps of the needy.

- Trust in the Most High for ever, for in the Lord Jehovah is everlasting strength; the Lord has many names, which is how one answers a Jehovah's Witness, for Jehovah is the Holy One of Israel.
- He bringeth down them that dwell on high, the lofty cities of the nations, and layeth them low even to the dust, so that the feet of the poor and the steps of the needy tread them down.
  - **[Isaiah 12:1-2,6](/bible/isaiah/12#v1)**
    > <sup>[1](/bible/isaiah/12#v1)</sup> And in that day thou shalt say, O Lord, I will praise thee: though thou wast angry with me, thine anger is turned away, and thou comfortedst me.
    >
    > <sup>[2](/bible/isaiah/12#v2)</sup> Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid: for the Lord Jehovah is my strength and my song; he also is become my salvation.
    >
    > <sup>[6](/bible/isaiah/12#v6)</sup> Cry out and shout, thou inhabitant of Zion: for great is the Holy One of Israel in the midst of thee.

    In that day Israel praises Him; the Lord Jehovah is my strength and my salvation, and great is the Holy One of Israel in the midst of thee, the same God.

**[Isaiah 26:7-9](/bible/isaiah/26#v7)**

> <sup>[7](/bible/isaiah/26#v7)</sup> The way of the just is uprightness: thou, most upright, dost weigh the path of the just.
>
> <sup>[8](/bible/isaiah/26#v8)</sup> Yea, in the way of thy judgments, O Lord, have we waited for thee; the desire of our soul is to thy name, and to the remembrance of thee.
>
> <sup>[9](/bible/isaiah/26#v9)</sup> With my soul have I desired thee in the night; yea, with my spirit within me will I seek thee early: for when thy judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.

- The way of the just is uprightness, and Israel waits patiently in the way of His judgments, desiring His name; with the soul and spirit they seek Him early.
- When His judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness, for right now the wicked are lofty and in high places; when Christ returns there will be no more celebrating Christmas and the other pagan holidays.
  - **[1 John 5:19](/bible/1-john/5#v19)**
    > <sup>[19](/bible/1-john/5#v19)</sup> And we know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in wickedness.

    The whole world lieth in wickedness, keeping none of the commandments, until the judgments come.

**[Isaiah 26:10-12](/bible/isaiah/26#v10)**

> <sup>[10](/bible/isaiah/26#v10)</sup> Let favour be shewed to the wicked, yet will he not learn righteousness: in the land of uprightness will he deal unjustly, and will not behold the majesty of the Lord.
>
> <sup>[11](/bible/isaiah/26#v11)</sup> Lord, when thy hand is lifted up, they will not see: but they shall see, and be ashamed for their envy at the people; yea, the fire of thine enemies shall devour them.
>
> <sup>[12](/bible/isaiah/26#v12)</sup> Lord, thou wilt ordain peace for us: for thou also hast wrought all our works in us.

- Even when favour is showed to the wicked, he will not learn righteousness and will not behold the majesty of the Most High; His hand is lifted up, but they will not see until they are ashamed and the fire of His enemies devours them.
- The Most High ordains, meaning establishes, peace for His people, for He has wrought all our works in us; this is the peace of verse 3, kept for those who enter through the straight gate of verse 2.

**[Isaiah 26:13-15](/bible/isaiah/26#v13)**

> <sup>[13](/bible/isaiah/26#v13)</sup> O Lord our God, other lords beside thee have had dominion over us: but by thee only will we make mention of thy name.
>
> <sup>[14](/bible/isaiah/26#v14)</sup> They are dead, they shall not live; they are deceased, they shall not rise: therefore hast thou visited and destroyed them, and made all their memory to perish.
>
> <sup>[15](/bible/isaiah/26#v15)</sup> Thou hast increased the nation, O Lord, thou hast increased the nation: thou art glorified: thou hadst removed it far unto all the ends of the earth.

- Other lords, the nations, have had dominion over Israel even to this day, but by Him only will they make mention of His name. Those dead lords are deceased and shall not rise, for He visits and destroys them and makes their memory to perish.
- He has increased the nation and is glorified, removing it far unto all the ends of the earth.

**[Isaiah 26:16-18](/bible/isaiah/26#v16)**

> <sup>[16](/bible/isaiah/26#v16)</sup> Lord, in trouble have they visited thee, they poured out a prayer when thy chastening was upon them.
>
> <sup>[17](/bible/isaiah/26#v17)</sup> Like as a woman with child, that draweth near the time of her delivery, is in pain, and crieth out in her pangs; so have we been in thy sight, O Lord.
>
> <sup>[18](/bible/isaiah/26#v18)</sup> We have been with child, we have been in pain, we have as it were brought forth wind; we have not wrought any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.

- In trouble and affliction Israel has visited Him and poured out a prayer under His chastening, for in affliction the people seek the Most High early.
- Like a woman with child drawing near to delivery who cries out in her pains, so Israel has been in His sight, for the people are catching hell; they have been in pain and brought forth only wind, working no deliverance in the earth.

**[Isaiah 26:19-21](/bible/isaiah/26#v19)**

> <sup>[19](/bible/isaiah/26#v19)</sup> Thy dead men shall live, together with my dead body shall they arise. Awake and sing, ye that dwell in dust: for thy dew is as the dew of herbs, and the earth shall cast out the dead.
>
> <sup>[20](/bible/isaiah/26#v20)</sup> Come, my people, enter thou into thy chambers, and shut thy doors about thee: hide thyself as it were for a little moment, until the indignation be overpast.
>
> <sup>[21](/bible/isaiah/26#v21)</sup> For, behold, the Lord cometh out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity: the earth also shall disclose her blood, and shall no more cover her slain.

- The dead men shall live and rise; awake and sing, ye that dwell in dust, for the earth shall cast out the dead. This is the deliverance, tied to the chariots that gather the people.
- The people are told to enter into their chambers and hide themselves for a little moment until the indignation is past, until the Most High destroys the nations, for He cometh out of His place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity, and the earth shall disclose her blood and no more cover her slain.
